Demo.page.php: This page shows nearly all htm_ functions of the library. Each card is one group of functions.
Cards: click a card header to fold it. The icons at the right change the height and width, or fold all cards. Drag the grip in the lower right corner to resize a card.
View bar (upper right): zoom, full screen, column view, language, your notes, this help and the theme.
The forms on this page are demos - nothing is saved on the server.
CustomerOrder.page.php: An example of a real business page: customer data, order lines and settings, built only with htm_ functions.
CVR lookup: type a CVR number or a company name and click Search - the data comes from the Danish company register.
Order lines: the total of each line is calculated from quantity, price, discount and VAT. Add row adds an empty line.
This is a demo: the Save buttons do not store anything.
other.page.php: htm_Alert, htm_Banner, htm_Badge show messages and labels. htm_ConfirmPostLink asks before an action that changes data. htm_TableTools adds search and sorting to a table.
card.page.php: A card is made with htm_Card_() and closed with htm_Card_end(). Everything in between is the content.
With form: the card is also a form, and htm_Card_end(subm:true) adds the save button.
documentation.page.php: What is new in the version, links to the overview of all functions and to the source on GitHub.
tinyEditor.page.php: TinyMCE edits formatted text. Your changes are kept in this browser session only - Download saves the text as a file on your computer.
